//: Type-checks webcrypto.js against the interface definitions jco derives
from wit/. `generated/` is produced on demand by `just jco::typecheck`, so
there is no checked-in copy to go stale.
`lib` is DOM, not Node: the host must load unchanged in a browser, so it
must type-check against the browser's globals and nothing else.
DOM.AsyncIterable is what lets a web `ReadableStream` satisfy the
`AsyncIterable` shape the generated stream types use.
